integrity: Self-contained mathematical proof and executable Python standard-library checks included; all embedded file hashes are computed from serialized decoded UTF-8 bytes. Finite verification is not presented as an infinite proof.
scientific_limitations: Applies only to synchronous, open-neighbor, tie-retaining binary majority on equally sized three-part complete graphs. Historical priority is qualified, especially because a relevant early general threshold-function paper was inspected only at abstract level. The limit equivalence is asymptotic, and independent scientific validation is outstanding.
title: Exact two-step majority attractor basins on \(K_{n,n,n}\)
